author: HeldOutPrintf

edits.old:
printf 'REGRESSION: SETUP (case-tally mismatch: cases=%s counted=%s)\n' \
      "$nlegs" "$((npass + nfail + nsetup))"
edits.new:
printf 'REGRESSION: SETUP (case-tally mismatch: cases=%d counted=%d)\n' \
      "$nlegs" "$((npass + nfail + nsetup))"

edits.old:
printf 'REGRESSION: PASS (cases=%s passed=%s; ledger legs exact: killed-delta<=0 flips<=0)\n' \
    "$nlegs" "$npass"
edits.new:
printf 'REGRESSION: PASS (cases=%d passed=%d; ledger legs exact: killed-delta<=0 flips<=0)\n' \
    "$nlegs" "$npass"

rationale: Only the printf format specifiers of the four printed REGRESSION lines change from %s to %d; every argument is an integer, so all printed bytes, exit codes and harness verdicts are unchanged.
